cards.label: What the pavilion does: walk, traditions, light, rides, tours and curation

items.title: Fifteen spaces, one rotunda
items.body: Forecourt, Earth Room, the court under the dome, Galleries A to C, the Parikrama, Red Room and Sphere Well.

items.title: Twenty-one ways with clay
items.body: Bankura, Molela and Longpi in the galleries, and eighteen more in the Red Room's five regional bays.

items.title: Sun through the oculus
items.body: Five times of day, a sun dial on Kharagpur time, monsoon rain, diyas at dusk and four quality tiers.

items.title: To the dome, into the well
items.body: Rail rides to the balcony, to the Sky Rim 20 m above the lotus, and round the Sphere Well's spiral.

items.title: Tours, guided or live
items.body: A 21-stop guided tour, signed docent tours with chat and raised hands, a clay passport, and VR.

items.title: An admin for curators
items.body: Exhibitions, makers, media, deep zoom and scan import, history with restore, trash and an activity log.
